artworks.dimensions:

artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This image depicts a pastoral scene with a man and a woman standing on a dirt path. The man holds a stick, and a dog is herding sheep along the path. The landscape includes dense foliage, a wooden fence, and a horizon with clouds. The color palette is sepia with detailed brushstrokes defining the figures and elements. In the background, there is a small silhouette of a house on a hill.

artworks.title: Drifting
artworks.dimensions:
image: 329 x 545 mm
sheet:  524 x 696 mm
plate:   401 x 602 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image features a seascape with sailboats in a sepia-toned etching style. The horizon is high, with sailboats dominating the view. A sailboat closest to the viewer creates ripples in the water, reflecting its sails. Other vessels of different sizes can be seen in the distance, including steamships. The brushstrokes are fine and precise, providing a detailed look. The color palette is subdued with warm sepia tones, evoking a classic feel.

artworks.title: A Smuggler's Landing Place
artworks.dimensions:

artworks.description: The image shows a view of the seaside from the shore. The horizon, waves, a sailing ship, and a rugged coastline are visible. The sky is cloudy, and the scene is done in fine lines typical of etching. The color palette is monochromatic in black, gray, and white. The water has curling waves, creating a sense of movement.

artworks.title: Twilight
artworks.dimensions:
image: 182 x 275 mm
paper: 328 x 443 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a low angle view of a group of sheep grazing near a rustic shelter. The horizon is low in the composition with a hint of sky above the shelter. Intricate line work and cross-hatching are used to depict the sheep and shelter, with a monochromatic color palette dominated by blacks and browns. A small house or barn with smoke rising from its chimney is visible on the right side of the image.

artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a sepia-toned etching of the Alamo building viewed from a direct perspective. The image depicts the building's façade with a low horizon. The detailed texture of the architecture, trees, a man on a horse, and a dog on the street is visible in fine, deliberate strokes. The color palette consists of varying shades of brown. In the distance, there are silhouettes of trees surrounding the building, and the sky has wispy clouds.

artworks.description: The sketch depicts a person in side profile, showing their upper torso and head. The individual's face is turned slightly to the left, with facial features including a slightly upturned nose, downcast eyes, and wavy short to medium-length hair. They are wearing a wide-brimmed hat, a coat with a fur collar, and a small earring. The background is neutral with crosshatching textures.

artworks.title: Honeysuckle
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a woman in a profile view facing left. She has softly defined facial features with a delicate nose and closed lips. Her hair is styled back and covered by a transparent veil. She is wearing a blouse with a high collar and a bow at the neck. The background shows blurry, organic shapes resembling foliage. At the bottom of the portrait is a sketch of a hummingbird near a flower with the name Frederick W. Freer inscribed.

artworks.title: The Tow
artworks.dimensions:
image: 299 x 477 mm
sheet:  382 x 579 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The artwork depicts a scene at water level featuring a large steamboat in the center. The horizon is low in the image, above the base of the steamboat. The sky is expansive with swirling clouds. Fine etching lines are used for texture, seen in the smoke and water ripples. The color scheme is sepia and black. Smaller sail vessels are scattered across the water, diminishing in size towards the distant horizon where water and sky merge. The detailed rendering and soft tones convey a serene maritime setting.

artworks.title: Gloucester Harbor
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor scene with a slightly elevated perspective overlooking the water. The horizon with ships and industrial buildings is visible. The brushstrokes give the image an atmospheric quality. The color palette is monochrome with grays and blacks. Wooden docks and pilings are on the left with a figure standing on them. A small boat or barge is on the right. In the distance, ships with tall masts and structures are visible merging into the cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Untitled (Moonlight Stroll)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 421 x 673 mm
sheet:  610 x 864 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene from an elevated point of view facing a body of water. The horizon is positioned at the top third of the composition. A crescent moon is visible in the sky, reflecting on the water. A row of trees lines the horizon. The brushstrokes are fine and detailed, creating a stippled texture. The color palette is dominated by sepia tones. In the foreground, a woman stands on a path among tall grasses, looking towards the water where wooden boats are moored. The landscape extends into a mix of trees and a hillside.

artworks.title: The Way to the River
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a wooded pathway with a woman walking along it. The point of view is positioned slightly above ground level, providing a view of the path that winds into the woodland. Close to us, the path is lined with brush and foliage, leading the viewer's eye towards the woman standing further along the path, surrounded by trees. She stands upright, wearing a long dress and a bonnet, with one hand to her chin. The horizon is not prominently visible, as the composition focuses more on the trees and natural elements that extend into the distance, becoming less defined against the sky. The style of the etching involves intricate, closely spaced lines that create texture and depth, especially in the depiction of the trees and underbrush. The color palette is monochromatic, relying solely on shades of black and white. In the background, the path continues to recede into the forest, framed by tall trees etched with fine detail to show their branches and leaves.

artworks.title: Homeward Bound

artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a small boat named "Water Lily." One person is a young woman with braided hair, wearing a hat, blouse, and skirt. The other person is a man with a beard, wearing a hat, shirt, and vest. They are focused on navigating through choppy waters. The background shows a vast sea with a distant sailboat and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Riva Delgi Schiavoni, No. 1

artworks.description: The image shows a busy port scene from an elevated viewpoint. The background features the horizon, buildings, and ship masts. The artwork conveys detailed linework and a monochromatic color palette using black and white shades. The foreground includes figures and market stalls, while ships docked at the quay and distant buildings complete the scene.

artworks.title: Smelters - Pittsburgh
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 85 x 161 mm
sheet: 156 x 252 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an industrial setting with large cylindrical structures and billowing smoke. The scene shows large vertical tanks or chimneys which seem to be part of an industrial complex, such as a factory or refinery. There are people in the foreground engaged in labor-intensive activity. The environment features large structures, scaffolding, and pipes. The drawing has high contrast with detailed shading that enhances depth and texture, creating a gritty and robust atmosphere. The lines are bold yet intricate, emphasizing the mechanical and powerful nature of the industrial scene.

artworks.title: Antique Shop, New York
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 189 x 175 mm
sheet: 234 x 228 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a courtyard viewed from the street, surrounded by buildings. The horizon line is obscured by architectural elements. At the center is an entryway leading into the courtyard bordered by windows filled with assorted items, possibly from an antique shop. The architectural details are depicted with fine crosshatchings and strokes for texture. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown. In the distance, stone and woodwork details can be seen in the courtyard. The upper section shows windows on a taller building.

artworks.title: Greylock
artworks.dimensions:
image: 190 x 245 mm
primary sheet: 260 x 306 mm
secondary sheet: 290 x 383 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape seen from an elevated perspective. A range of hills and mountains obscure the horizon. In the foreground, there is a bare tree to the center-left, a stone wall stretching leftward, and shrubbery and trees to the right. A small building is seen amidst fields, providing depth perception. In the far distance, a town is faintly visible with structures and smokestacks on the horizon. The sky above displays dense, turbulent clouds. The artwork features a monochromatic color palette of various shades of gray that highlight the texture and detail of the brushstrokes or etching.

artworks.title: Morning
artworks.dimensions:
image: 206 x 304 mm
paper: 291 x 393 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon line is in the middle of the image with silhouettes of trees against a cloudy sky. Above the trees, there are distant clouds and scattered birds. The brushwork mimics an etching with fine details for trees and grass. The palette consists of gradients of gray. In the foreground, there are thin grassy patches and individual trees standing in a field.

artworks.title: Untitled (Woman Driving Carriage)
artworks.dimensions:
image: 207 x 186 mm
sheet:  375 x 347 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of a woman's body. She is seated and slightly turned to the side, holding reins with her arms extended forward and leaning slightly back. She has delicate facial features, looks forward with a composed expression, and has neatly-styled hair, likely tied up or tucked under a wide-brimmed hat adorned with a decorative feather and ribbons. She wears a long-sleeved gown with a high collar, giving a sense of elegance. The background is minimally detailed with simple, sketch-like lines, possibly hinting at movement across an open space.

artworks.title: The Mora Players
artworks.dimensions:
image: 160 x 245 mm
sheet:  320 x 412 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts two young boys sitting facing each other on the ground. The boy on the left has short, dark hair and is dressed in light-colored shirt, dark vest, and pants. He is reaching out his hands towards the other boy. The boy on the right has short, dark hair and is wearing a dark jacket and pants with a lighter shirt. He is leaning slightly towards the first boy, with one hand extended and the other on his leg. The background is plain with a partition or shadow on the wall behind them, and a wooden box or crate is visible to the side.

artworks.title: Old Gloucester Shore
artworks.dimensions:
image: 199 x 302 mm
sheet:  340 x 444 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image depicts a coastal landscape with sailboats in a harbor. A dirt path winds towards rocky outcroppings along the water's edge, surrounded by grass and shrubs. Rustic cottages with thatched roofs sit among leafy trees. The horizon is partially obscured by distant landforms and sailboats near the shore. The sky has feathery clouds and the color palette is primarily sepia. The scene is detailed with fine strokes conveying movement and serenity.

artworks.title: Old New England Orchard
artworks.dimensions:
image: 205 x 305 mm
sheet:  362 x 491 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape scene from a slightly elevated point of view, showing the ground and trees in detail. The horizon line is not distinctly visible, and the ground slopes gently upward toward what could be considered the horizon, with trees positioned on and near this line. The artwork is rendered in a detailed engraving style with intricately crosshatched shadows and textures. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and sepia against an off-white paper. Closest to us, a few trees stand with partially bare branches, while beyond, more densely foliated trees suggest a lush grove or forested area. A solitary figure wearing a dark coat and hat stands amidst this landscape, interacting with the earth using a tool.

artworks.title: St. John's River, Florida
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows a view from the water toward a distant shoreline with structures. The horizon is visible with the land meeting the sky. There are tall trees on the right side and a small boat with passengers creating ripples in the water. More boats and structures are in the distance. The artwork is a fine etching with detailed linework and a monochromatic color palette of grays.

artworks.title: A Group of Willows
artworks.dimensions:
image: 193 x 279 mm
sheet:  259 x 339 mm
plate:   211 x 297 mm
artworks.creditLine: Reba and Dave Williams Collection, Gift of Reba and Dave Williams
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a view from under a dense canopy of trees. Large, gnarled trunks dominate the foreground, with two deer grazing on grass in the distance. The horizon is where the grassy field meets a smaller wooded area. The etching technique features fine lines for texture and depth, particularly in the tree bark and leaves. The color palette is monochromatic, with dark lines contrasting against light beige paper to enhance texture and shadows.
